attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole entry is two sentences: that the Church commemorates him together with the martyr Celestine, and that «Δεν έχουμε όμως πληροφορίες για τον βίο του» — we have no information about his life. It carries no asterisk: an absence of material, not a refusal to vouch. **The folder carries no `types`**: the page gives him only «Άγιος» and does not extend Celestine's rank of martyr to him, and the closed list has no slug for a bare saint. Nothing in the corpus answers to the name in any form. Because the page gives nothing at all to distinguish him by, the display name carries the day. `celestine-martyr-25-may`, whom he is commemorated with, is upgraded in `up-05-25.json`; he is named in the life without a link, since no `related` row can be added from a reader's new-folder draft to a folder whose own life does not name him back.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
